actor.name: Mistral AI (Vibe, AI Studio)
actor.description: Vibe (ex-Le Chat) Work Mode proposes plans and waits for approval; AI Studio offers runtime, observability, registry with promotion gates, self-hosted option; EU hosting by default.

note: EU-resident model provider; AI Studio also a benchmark. Traction: EUR 3B Series D Sep 2026 at >EUR 21B (secondary) (https://valueaddvc.com/blog/mistral-ai-valuation-revenue-2026-europe-ai-champion). Licence: Proprietary platform; some open-weight models.
